title: FBN Fulfillment Fee Terms
content:
Every unit shipped from Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) inventory for a marketplace order is billed the fulfillment fee of its size tier at the program in force on the ship date. The fee is billed once per order and SKU and is not credited when the buyer later returns or is refunded for the item.

## Amount

The fulfillment fee of an order line is the units shipped multiplied by the per-unit fulfillment fee of the SKU's size tier (small standard, large standard, large bulky or extra large) in the program in force on the ship date, rounded to the cent.

## Points of application

- **One fee per order and SKU.** An order line is billed once, for all units of that SKU shipped on the order.
- **Ship date governs.** A program change after the ship date does not reprice the fee.
- **Returns and refunds.** A later buyer return or refund of the item does not credit the fulfillment fee.

Worked illustration (hypothetical rate, not a program figure): 3 units of a large standard SKU at a per-unit fee of 5.00 USD bill 15.00 USD on that order line; if the buyer later returns one unit, the 15.00 USD stays billed.
